title: I Made my dream game myself using AI as a tool!
author: Xanma_6aki
selftext: I made chatgpt generate concept art, sent into codex, kept telling it "make it better" until I made this masterpiece! Feels like I'm a true game director

replies.author: Xanma_6aki
replies.body: I feel like it's still too minimalist tho, any suggestions for something more I can throw in?

replies.author: UndeniablyRuthless
replies.body: Space travel, and species discovery with cave explorations and customizations. Space creature breading and combat system

replies.author: Xanma_6aki
replies.body:
Ill add that when codex is done.

I told it now to add souls like combat and nether portal

comments.author: Affectionate_Fact854
comments.body:
Waaaay to cluttered, you tried mashing roguelite, minecradt, path of exiles and tower defense all into a single game 

RIP

replies.author: Xanma_6aki
replies.body: Actually it was more, it was Megabonk, Muck, Milkraid, Backpack battles, League of legends and Path of exile

comments.author: Wrong-Month-4895
comments.body: Hey brother don’t worry about the haters. You made something that you’re happy about and that is all that matters. I am halfway through my dream game as well and love seeing the progress!

comments.author: thetinytrex
comments.body: I was going to say something positive like "keep going if you love the game" -- that was until I read you just told Codex to "make it better" and think you're a game director. And now I'm sure you're just a troll.

replies.author: Xanma_6aki
replies.body: ?? I'm only using it as a tool

replies.author: Valdaraak
replies.body:
There's a right way and a wrong way to use a tool though. "Make it better" isn't the right way to use AI as a tool in game development. If you give AI no direction, you get trash for output.

*You* might think you made a masterpiece, but that's personal bias. It's not a masterpiece. It doesn't even look that good or fun. It looks like you threw a bunch of game titles into a blender and kept pulsing it until you got something you liked. No direction, no guidance, no *development*. Just pulling the slot machine lever over and over.

replies.author: Xanma_6aki
replies.body: Chatgpt said Codex could fix planning for me so no thanks

replies.author: Valdaraak
replies.body: Ah, so you *are* a troll, just like others suspected.

replies.author: Xanma_6aki
replies.body:
No, it's just a tool and there's no right or wrong way to use it.

If you go to a restaurant and order food, is there a right or wrong way to order the food?
